note: Development set: the v1 questions, seen and reused freely during iteration. requires = at least one call of the tool whose arguments contain these values (lists: subset; concepts as level:code; target_levels: a target concept at one of these levels); forbids = no call may match. Q18 also accepts limited (a cross-channel frequency comparison is outside the comparison rules). v2 (2026-10-17): answerable questions accept answered or limited but must cite numbers (needs_numbers); sparse questions Q11-Q12 accept both with a must_not on conclusions; Q24 may split the two impacts.
